issues.explanation: This is a compositional numeral-classifier phrase, not a lexicalized word.
“广” is an adverb modifying the verb “收”; the ordinary compositional phrase should be split.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into “广” meaning “extensively” and “收” meaning “take in/recruit”.

issues.explanation: This combines the numeral with the unit noun “方” and should not be treated as one word.
issues.suggested_fix: Split into “三十六” and “方”; explain “方” here as an administrative division/unit.

issues.explanation: This is a compositional quantity phrase containing an approximate number, “万,” and “人,” not one word.
In “在幽州招募义兵,” “在” is a locative preposition introducing the place, not a grammatical particle.
issues.suggested_fix: Classify it as a preposition and explain it as “in/at”.

issues.explanation: As a common lexical group name classified as a word, the pinyin should not begin with an unnecessary capital letter.
This is annotated as a word/title rather than a personal name, so the pinyin capitalization is inconsistent with the segment type.
issues.suggested_fix: Use “tiāngōng jiāngjūn” or the project’s consistent lowercase title convention.

issues.explanation: “传到” is better analyzed as a verb with “到” as a result complement indicating that the proclamation reached the destination; calling it a generic “趋向结果结构” is imprecise.
issues.suggested_fix: Use a pattern such as “动词 + 到”结果补语，表示传递后到达某处, meaning “be conveyed to and reach a place.”
